title: 定制的枕头
prompt: Create a high-resolution 3D render of the [BRAND] logo designed as an inflatable, puffy object. The logo should appear soft, rounded, and air-filled – like a plush balloon or blow-up toy. Use a smooth, matte texture with subtle fabric creases and stitching to emphasize the inflatable look. Position the logo at a 45-degree angle to highlight depth and realism. Place the final result on a couch in a stylish living room with furniture and decor that matches the iconic colors of the [BRAND] logo. Output dimension: 1080x1080.
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro 模型，打造柔软充气的品牌标识，适用于品牌推广和室内设计项目，通过细腻纹理和立体角度呈现逼真视觉效果。
